_comment: Tier-2: DamHydroConditionLoadProcess only SETS nodal POSITIVE_FACE_PRESSURE; nothing applies it as a force unless load conditions exist, and DamApplication registers no 2D pressure condition of its own — use SMA's LineLoadCondition2D2N on the wet face. Pitfall (kratos.dam #2). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). LineLoadCondition2D2N constructs; the Dam-flavoured spellings a reader might guess (DamLineLoadCondition2D2N, HydroLineLoadCondition2D2N) are not registered, confirming that the condition has to come from StructuralMechanics. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 INVERTS the expected registration status of all 3 entities -- it claims the opposite of what this build registers, while still really calling CreateNewElement/CreateNewCondition for each name. Every registered[...] line then disagrees with itself and registry_mismatches goes from 0 to 3. This proves the booleans come from a real registry lookup on this build and that a wrong claim is caught. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: all 3 registered[<name>]=<got>_expected=<must> lines, registry_mismatches=0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/dam_needs_sma_line_load_condition && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
